note: The theme allowlist (issue 050, M1). A theme is ONE stylesheet of --wa-* tokens on :root, plus an optional data-layout class for genuinely different arrangements. Selection may only ever name a key from this file — never a URL, never a query parameter (the issue-041 rule: nothing outside the repo decides what the page loads). CI checks every listed sheet declares exactly the tokens default.css declares, so a half-finished candidate fails the build instead of shipping with holes.
